# Free LLM Council (OpenCode LLM Council)

> 100% Free, Local-First Multi-Model Deliberation Engine powered by OpenCode with optional BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) hybrid cloud seating.

Free LLM Council is an open-source consensus and decision-making platform inspired by Andrej Karpathy's experimental concept. It replaces costly per-token OpenRouter API calls by running multi-model debates natively on your local OpenCode service with zero token fees, unlimited runs, and complete privacy.

## Key Information

- **Primary Repository:** https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/llm-council-pro-max
- **Local Engine:** OpenCode (https://opencode.ai)
- **Supported Providers:** Local OpenCode (Free/Default), OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek (BYOK)
- **Tech Stack:** Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SSE, React 19, Vite, Lucide-style SVG vector icons

## Core Architecture & Workflow

1. **Stage 1 — Independent Opening Positions:** Seated models research the prompt independently using read-only live web search and workspace tools.
2. **Stage 2 — Multi-Round Named Debate:** Models engage in structured multi-round debate by name, specifically rebutting peers, conceding persuasive points, declaring updates, and surfacing tradeoffs. Supports Caveman compression (lite, full, ultra) for up to ~48% intermediate token savings.
3. **Stage 3 — Blind Peer Review:** Opening positions are anonymized as Response A, B, C... Models score peer reasoning blindly to generate a bias-free aggregate ranking matrix.
4. **Stage 4 — Chairman Synthesis & Verdict:** The highest-capacity reasoning model synthesizes the transcript into an executive decision: Decision, Reasoning, Tradeoffs, Dissent, and Confidence Score. Includes automatic failover if the primary chairman model stalls.

## Key Capabilities

- **100% Free & Unlimited:** Runs completely free on local OpenCode models without API bills or 429 rate limits.
- **BYOK Hybrid Cloud Seating:** Seat Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, o1, or DeepSeek R1 alongside local free models via in-app API key modal.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Steering:** Mid-debate injection of operator guidance and reference URLs taking effect in subsequent rounds and the verdict.
- **Workspace Project Folders:** Organize deliberations into folders, move debates between folders, rename inline, or archive/restore completed sessions.
- **Dual Deliberation Reports & Interactive Viewer:** Toggle between Executive Brief and Deep-Dive Technical Matrix reports (ASCII deliberation flows, model comparative matrix, and strategic trade-off analysis).
- **Modern Studio UI:** Single-window non-scrolling dashboard, real-time stage progress rail (RunRail), expandable tool traces, zero raw emojis.

## Quickstart

```bash
# 1. Start OpenCode server
opencode service start

# 2. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/llm-council-pro-max.git
cd llm-council-pro-max

# 3. Install dependencies
uv sync # or pip install -e .
cd frontend && npm install && cd ..

# 4. Start backend (:8001) and frontend (:5173)
./start.sh
```

## REST API Overview

- `GET /api/models`: Discover active local OpenCode and configured cloud models.
- `GET /api/conversations`: List deliberation metadata with project folder hierarchy and archived status.
- `POST /api/conversations`: Create a new deliberation session.
- `POST /api/conversations/{id}/message`: Stream a council run using Server-Sent Events (SSE).
- `POST /api/conversations/{id}/steer`: Inject mid-flight human operator guidance directives.
- `GET /api/conversations/{id}/reports`: Retrieve pre-rendered Executive and Detailed reports for in-app viewing.
- `GET /api/conversations/{id}/export/report?format=executive|detailed`: Download formatted Markdown report.
- `GET /api/conversations/{id}/export/zip`: Download deliberation archive package (.zip) containing both reports.
- `GET /api/providers/keys`: Retrieve safe redacted status for configured BYOK provider keys.
- `POST /api/providers/keys`: Save dynamic provider API key in-memory.
